mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT pq.currency FROM prj_quotation pq where pq.source_document_id = cc.contract_id and pq.source_document_category = 'CON_CONTRACT') as currency, cc.contract_id, hfp.funding_plan_id, cprh.payment_req_id, pp.loan_initial_lease, hfp.loan_total_amount, hfp.loan_net_amount, cprh.payment_req_number, hfp.status, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE code = 'HLS_WFL_STATUS' and code_value = cprh.transfer_status) status_n, pp.contract_number, pp.tenant_id, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = pp.tenant_id ) as bp_name, cc.contract_number as defray_number , hfp.proposed_launch_date, cprh.created_by, cprh.creation_date , (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su where su.user_id = cprh.created_by) as application_name, cprh.creation_date as application_date, cprh.process_instance_id FROM con_contract cc, hls_funding_plan hfp, prj_project pp, csh_payment_req_hd cprh cc.contract_id = hfp.contract_id and cc.project_id = pp.project_id and hfp.funding_plan_id = cprh.funding_plan_id -- and cprh.transfer_status = 'APPROVED' and cc.contract_id = #{contractId}
